description: List a filesystem's S3 keys: access_key_id, name, mode, expires_at and revoked; never their secrets. The bucket is the filesystem ID at https://s3.mountable.io (path-style). Creating a key is not a tool, because its answer is the key's secret: run `mountable api-keys create` or `mountable s3-keys create` (or use the SDKs) where the backend stores it. Needs a management key (mtblm_) or the login of an owner or admin; an API key gets management_key_required. org_id is optional: a key uses its own organisation, and a login with one organisation uses that one. Read-only and safe to retry. On rate_limited, wait retry_after seconds before retrying.
name: list_s3_keys
